verdict.rationale: Convex documents a first-party Convex Auth library that builds sign-up/sign-in flows with social identity providers, passwords, and one-time email/SMS codes. It also documents integrations with Clerk, WorkOS AuthKit, and Auth0 as alternatives. The core story is covered, but Convex Auth is scoped to client-side React and React Native apps. missing for 10: evidence for the 'in minutes' setup speed (quickstart or step counts), Convex Auth support beyond client-side React/React Native, independent or hands-on corroboration.
